sources.title: CVE-2026-7482: Ollama GGUF Heap Out-of-Bounds Read — Full Technical ...
sources.snippet: CVE-2026-7482 is a critical heap out-of-bounds read in Ollama's GGUF model loader (CVSS 9.1). Unauthenticated remote attackers can leak ~2 MB of heap memory per request — including environment variables, API keys, system prompts, and concurrent users' conversation data. Two-bug chain, full PoC, patch diff, and Ollama 0.17.1 fix.
